description: Default lineage of a raw relation per source family, by relation-name prefix (first match wins). Gold public.app_* rows mix ETL copies and staging-native rows, so their raw default is the unconfirmed gold_native_staging; curated files add row-level rules. A relation no rule matches is excluded.
note: Lineage is the unconfirmed per-schema default; curated bindings add row-level lineage rules.
